#0 blossom — the wish holds while the wind disperses: attract pointer at 0.3 (the wish to hold), circulation −0.2 (the west wind's drift), auto-wind, a sine LFO on field.params.dispersion — the shaking breathes; the west-wind ring carries a gentle repel (the force that carries beauty away is gentle); the blossom sign falls — ❀ bright and small → pale and scattered, its own position drifting with the wind. Duration 12.
#1 river — THE 3D SCENE. z is the landscape's receding: the fruit nearest the hand (z +0.4, the share to take), the valley at middle distance (z 0, addressed as one's own), the river deepest (z −0.45, the element that cannot be kept for a repeat encounter) — the swimmer's participation is a motion in depth. vortex + pulse pointer (the current); vortex3d + depth occlusion with green-black tint; auto-current, a sine LFO on circulation — the current breathes; the fruit's sequence gold-full → taken (smaller, dimmed); the river's ring narrows as it passes — same water never twice. Duration 11 — the river's quicker passage.
#2 body — line layout: the body's powers in articulated series; repel + shove pointer (loss takes away), turbulence 0.15 (the storm's field); the body sequence walks the German whole's own words — Lippe → Fuß → Hand → ∘△✋ paled and dimmed (declared all changed); der Name added as its own formation — ≈ arriving bright, drifting toward the rim and fading (hurrying toward the element). Duration 13.
#4 muses — ring layout: beginning and end held in the round; attract + implode pointer (the gathering joins what passage separated); auto-gather, a sine LFO on pointerStrength — the gathering's pull breathes; the Muses' ♪ carries an attract force (the favour draws); the joined sign's sequence walks ⊙⊙ → ❀ → ⊙⊙ — the opening's own blossom received inside the ending's joined pair. Duration 14, the longest beat — the gathering takes its time.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens with a blossom sign falling under a dispersing wind — a wish for one hour answered by loss inside the weather of flourishing — and closes with that same ❀ received inside ⊙⊙, beginning and end drawn together faster than objects flee, with content (♥) and form (the square) given their distinct places. The river that could not be swum twice (#1, the element held deepest in the 3D scene) is the element the wave hurries toward (#2) and the change the Muses' favour carries (#4): water never returns as the same substance; it is the medium the formed sequence crosses. The pointer arcs from the wish's weak holding (0.3 attract) through the current and the losses' shove to the gathering's breathing pull — holding, losing, and gathering are one force at three offices.

Mythemic verbs only: the poem demonstrates its answer; no formal entailment, no equating of poetic water with QL's 0.
